reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Bamboo Hyalu Water Boosting Cream 100ml
reviews.text: This moisturizer is so soothing and smooth to apply. It is my go-to morning moisturizer, and will probably be great for nights in the summer as well! Very hydrating and lovely.
reviews.zh: 呢款保濕霜用起嚟好舒緩、好滑。係我早上必用嘅保濕霜，夏天夜晚用應該都好啱！好保濕，好正。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Bamboo Hyalu Water Boosting Cream 100ml
reviews.text: I like how light it is. It’s great during the summer and maybe you need more if it’s winter - depends on your skin type
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢夠晒輕盈。夏天用一流，冬天用可能要搽多少少——視乎你嘅膚質。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Bamboo Hyalu Water Boosting Cream 100ml
reviews.text: I love water creams for absorption and the “lightness” of not feeling like you have something heavy on your skin. This one seems to irritate my mature skin (aka thin) skin near my eyes. However I also use on areas of my skin with tattoos in addition to sunscreen and they stay moisturized and supple.
reviews.zh: 我就鍾意水潤乳霜容易吸收同埋嗰種「輕盈」、感覺塊面冇負擔嘅感覺。不過呢款用落似乎刺激到我熟齡（即係偏薄）嘅眼周皮膚。但我喺有紋身嘅皮膚位置配搭防曬一齊用，皮膚都keep住有水分同柔軟。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Bamboo Hyalu Water Boosting Cream 100ml
reviews.text: Very nice cream. It’s thin so it goes on smooth and you can put in several layers without feeling too sticky. I doo feel like I need to reapply throughout the day, it’s not long lasting. But I don’t mind.
reviews.zh: 好正嘅乳霜。質地薄，所以搽起嚟好滑，可以疊搽幾層都唔會覺得太黏。的確覺得要成日補搽，唔算持久。不過我唔介意。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Bamboo Hyalu Water Boosting Cream 100ml
reviews.text: So far it is ok. The thin texture does not provide enough for my skin to feel hydrated abd moisturized for a long time. I like to spread it on top of a thin sheet mask to make my skin feel more plump. Probably will not repurchase.
reviews.zh: 暫時一般。薄薄嘅質地冇辦法令皮膚長時間覺得夠水同夠潤。我會將佢薄薄搽喺片裝面膜上面，等皮膚感覺更加飽滿。應該唔會回購。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Bamboo Hyalu Water Boosting Cream 100ml
reviews.text:
残念ながら届いた時にはもう箱が潰れてました…
商品自体は、アロエジェルみたいな感じです。パウダーをつけた後に頬を触ると潤いがある感じです。肝心のパウダー本体はこのクリームのせいで表面が固まってしまいました…
低刺激で潤いもあるけど、鎮静作用とか今の所分からないし、化粧の前に使うのはおすすめ出来ないです。
reviews.zh:
可惜收到嘅時候個箱已經被壓扁咗……
產品本身好似蘆薈gel嘅質感。搽完碎粉之後摸塊面會有水潤感。但最要命嘅係碎粉本身因為呢款乳霜嘅關係，成個表面結晒塊……
低刺激有水潤感，但鎮靜效果暫時仲感受唔到，唔建議妝前用。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Bamboo Hyalu Water Boosting Cream 100ml
reviews.text: Great cream. This light cream. I can compare this to the torriden cream. This works well for me. Light hydration non irritating
reviews.zh: 好正嘅乳霜。呢款輕身乳霜。可以同 torriden 嘅乳霜比。用落好啱我。輕盈保濕，唔刺激。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Bamboo Hyalu Water Boosting Cream 100ml
reviews.text:
I have oily skin and my go to moisturizer is iunik centella gel 
So i fined this moisturizer very weird. at first it is very nice on the skin and help inner dryness 
but. 
it leaves a slight film to it so i find this moisturizer suitable for those who do not produce a lot of oil or combination skin my sister with normal and sensitive skin now happy with it
reviews.zh:
我係油性肌，慣常用嘅保濕係 iunik 積雪草gel，
所以覺得呢款保濕好奇怪。初頭搽上面好舒服，可以紓緩肌底乾燥，
但。
佢會留低一層薄膜，所以我覺得呢款保濕比較啱乾性或者混合性肌嘅人，我啱正常同敏感肌嘅家姐用就覺得好滿意。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
